title: Minimum Number of Flips to Make Binary Grid Palindromic I
description:
You are given an m x n binary matrix grid . 
 
 A row or column is considered palindromic if its values read the same forward and backward. 
 
 You can flip any number of cells in grid from 0 to 1 , or from 1 to 0 . 
 
 Return the minimum number of cells that need to be flipped to make either all rows palindromic or all columns palindromic . 

 Example 1: 

 Input: grid = [[1,0,0],[0,0,0],[0,0,1]] 
 
 Output: 2 
 
 Explanation: 
 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2024/07/07/screenshot-from-2024-07-08-00-20-10.png] 
 
 Flipping the highlighted cells makes all the rows palindromic. 

 Example 2: 

 Input: grid = [[0,1],[0,1],[0,0]] 
 
 Output: 1 
 
 Explanation: 
 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2024/07/07/screenshot-from-2024-07-08-00-31-23.png] 
 
 Flipping the highlighted cell makes all the columns palindromic. 

 Example 3: 

 Input: grid = [[1],[0]] 
 
 Output: 0 
 
 Explanation: 
 
 All rows are already palindromic. 

 Constraints: 

 m == grid.length 
 
 n == grid[i].length 
 
 1 <= m * n <= 2 * 10 5 
 
 0 <= grid[i][j] <= 1
